name: Counting and Chance
description: Count outcomes carefully and turn the counts into probabilities.

lessonNames.l4-does-not-happen: The chance it does not happen

lessonObjectives.l1-every-outcome: List a sample space and pick out an event inside it.
lessonObjectives.l2-equally-likely: Compute a probability by counting, and check that the outcomes really are equally likely.
lessonObjectives.l3-events-as-sets: Combine events with union, intersection and complement.
lessonObjectives.l4-does-not-happen: Use the complement to turn a hard count into an easy one.
lessonObjectives.l5-in-stages: Count multi-stage outcomes with the multiplication rule.
lessonObjectives.l6-does-order-matter: Choose between ordered and unordered counts and convert between them.
lessonObjectives.l7-replacement: Count draws with and without replacement.
lessonObjectives.l8-stars-and-bars: Count ways to share identical items with stars and bars.
lessonObjectives.l9-double-counting: Use inclusion and exclusion for two and three events.
lessonObjectives.l10-birthday: Compute the chance that two people in a room share a birthday.
lessonObjectives.l11-axioms: State the axioms and derive simple consequences from them.
lessonObjectives.l12-poker-hands: Count poker hands and rank them by probability.
